notes.title: 恋爱猪脚饭发布啦！
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]各位项目经理们中午好，感谢各位一直以来的关注与支持，时隔半年，我们的游戏终于上线了！  《恋爱猪脚饭》是一款工地恋爱喜剧游戏，玩家将扮演负债累累流落城中村的破产老哥“黄夏”，与爱吃猪脚饭的女神施工员“陈嘉怡”邂逅开启工地逆袭人生。通过在游戏中做出选择，达成不同的故事结局。  首发折扣价仅需9.9元！折扣持续14天，用一碗猪脚饭不到的价格，来品尝一下赛博猪脚饭吧！  BUG反馈通道： QQ群：825611344 BUG反馈问卷：[/p][p][url="https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DQ0RWbmp6dWdDY1NH?right_flag=2#/fill"]https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DQ0RWbmp6dWdDY1NH?right_flag=2#/fill[/url][/p][p]  日志文件在C:\\Users\\\[USERNAME]\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Likeyou\\LoveZhu  您也可以邮件联系[/p][p][url="https://2038752123@qq.com，发送您的存档并描述问题，我们会尽快回复处理！"]2038752123@qq.com，发送您的存档并描述问题，我们会尽快回复处理！[/url][/p][p][/p][p]感谢您的支持！[/p][p][/p][p]Good afternoon, project managers. Thank you for your continuous attention and support. After half a year of hard work, our game is finally launched!  Love Braised Pork Rice is a construction site romance comedy game. Players will take on the role of "Huang Xia", a bankrupt man drowning in debt who ends up in an urban village. He encounters "Chen Jiayi", a goddess engineer who loves braised pork rice, and thus begins his journey of turning his life around at the construction site. By making choices in the game, players can unlock different story endings.  The launch discount price is only 9.9 yuan! The discount will last for 14 days. With a price lower than a real bowl of braised pork rice, come and savor this "cyber braised pork rice"!  BUG Feedback Channels:  QQ Group: 825611344 BUG Feedback Questionnaire: [/p][p][url="https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DQ0RWbmp6dWdDY1NH?right_flag=2#/fill"]https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DQ0RWbmp6dWdDY1NH?right_flag=2#/fill[/url][/p][p]  The log file is located at C:\\Users\[USERNAME]\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Likeyou\\LoveZhu.  You can also contact us via email at [/p][p][url="https://2038752123@qq.com"]2038752123@qq.com[/url][/p][p]. Please send your save file and describe the problem, and we will reply and handle it as soon as possible.[/p]
